description: Features, required journeys and coverage status. 'implemented' means the JSON exists and validates; 'verified' means a recorded live run passed on the revision in that run's provenance.json.

features.title: Committee office/company boundary and role-gated screens
features.notes: Access mode is shadow: registrar-only GET screens (new, transfers, registry, purposes) load for an ordinary employee; enforce mode must deny and is declared but not exercised live. The foreign-committee boundary (404) holds in both modes.
missing: enforce-mode denials exercised live

features.title: Committee types and rules (company administrator)

missing: type create/edit and national review
purpose bindings

features.title: Constitute, appoint, activate, replace, extend, suspend, dissolve
features.notes: Live inspection on 7 October 2026 showed the order wizard stating that no ministry committee rules are active. The order-readiness guard covers this message and required-file validation. No active type is available to complete constitution or amendment flows. A write journey also needs an authorized company catalogue actor, a synthetic signed-file fixture, and a cleanup/retention policy. Do not create a committee type or assign roles just to make this suite pass.

features.title: Capture and retain a signed committee order before forming a committee
missing: upload and save a synthetic signed order
resume and discard saved intake through the supported screen

features.notes: Login and header context are exercised inside other journeys via flow auth.login only.

missing: saving roles (write)
office that is not live yet

features.title: Organization boundaries: area ICT officer vs local office administrator vs national screens
features.notes: organization.office.manage and organization.national.manage are enforced in shadow mode too, and object scope (area / own office) returns 404, so the same statuses hold in both access modes.
missing: POST endpoints (probe supports GET only)
office administrator whose working context is another office

features.title: Administrators: Area ICT officers and Ministry administrators tabs, quiet Remove access, national review note
features.notes: Needs a super user; the seeded dataset has none, so the journey is blocked with fixtures.unsatisfied-requirements. Run it on a configured target with a super-admin login.
missing: give access and Restore access (national review; write)

features.title: Government directory preview and import action
missing: import through the national review (write)

features.title: Staff pages before go-live (waiting / no office)
features.notes: EnsureOfficeIsOperational, which renders readiness/waiting and readiness/unassigned, is not registered on any route or middleware group, so neither page can be reached live. Covered only by the feature test OrganizationUxTest.

features.title: My offices: current offices with status and home tag, roles with Hand over or a labelled Cancel, handovers waiting, updates and personal code (storekeeper)
missing: bn-BD labels (needs a session language switch; changing a user's locale is not allowed)
waiting, leaving, paused and ready-to-transfer offices (the seeded dataset has active memberships only)
switching the working office from a card
cancelling a join request and withdrawing a leave request (write; no seeded pending or leaving membership)

features.title: Join another office: office code checked first, unknown code explained under the field, personal code way
missing: a valid office code showing the office and sending a request (the seeded dataset has no office code; making one replaces an office's code)
making a personal code (write: creates a 24-hour token)

features.title: Leave an office: steps, readiness from the clearance rules, roles to hand over, consequences, acknowledgement and transfer tracker
features.notes: Checked for a storekeeper, who is blocked by their role; nothing is requested.
missing: asking to leave with a destination, then withdrawing (write; needs a seeded employee with no role, holdings or open requests)
the transfer tracker after sign-off

features.title: Hand over a role: colleague picker, note, pending slot with Cancel, whole-sentence request, decline with reason
features.notes: Write journey (suite journeys, --allow-writes). Blocked by preflight.mail-sink-unsafe on this installation (mail driver smtp); membership mail is disabled and unscheduled, so running it needs --allow-external-mail by an operator's decision.
missing: accepting a handover (moves a seeded role; no reversal except handing it back)
stale-role refusal

features.title: Office staff: five status tabs with counts, own row without End access, office code dialog, Add staff refusal keeps typed values
missing: approve / decline a join request, sign off a leaver, welcome a transferred employee, end additional access (writes; no seeded pending, leaving or arriving memberships)
search and paging beyond 25 rows

features.title: Office membership boundaries: own memberships only, Staff for office administrators, Emergency changes for super users
features.notes: membership.manage is enforced in shadow mode and membership.override is national, so the same statuses hold in both access modes; another person's membership returns 404.
missing: POST endpoints (probe supports GET only; covered by OfficeMembershipWorkflowTest)

features.title: Emergency changes: person search, reach preview, nothing preselected, one office per release with roles option, reason and acknowledgement
features.notes: Needs a super user; the seeded dataset has none, so a plain local run is blocked with fixtures.unsatisfied-requirements. Verified live on 2026-10-14 with --target local (super-admin bootstrap login). The title is checked by presence, not wording, because the super-admin may read the page in Bangla.
missing: submitting through the national review (write; the release cannot be undone)
change history entries
